pc_changelog:
v4.5.1 — Polish & Reliability Update

• Cleaner right-click menus: PDF actions in a clear order, one Convert menu, Show in Explorer at the top level
• New PDF Compare: pick the other PDF straight from your shelf, browse, or drop it in
• PDF tools pick files from the shelf in one click; Stamp, Split, Redact and Password show quick toasts instead of popups
• Notes keep the cursor in the card you click, so pastes land where you expect
• Clipboard background no longer changes when you switch Windows virtual desktops
• Smaller, tidier default Clipboard size (310 × 355); your saved size is kept
• Folder cards open in File Explorer from the Quick Look button; Ctrl+W closes Quick Look
• Large copies (hundreds of files) paste and open without freezing the shelf
• More reliable LAN transfers: idle timeouts, delivery tracking and correct queue order
